name: Brooding Lad Heathcliff

intro.text: I am Heathcliff! Well, I'm Kevin. But I've been brooding on this moor since Tuesday and it's going brilliantly.
Battle me, and the wind shall howl!

win: Cathy! Oh. No. Just the wind.
after: Wuthering means the roaring of the wind on high ground. Emily used a Yorkshire word and the whole world learnt it.
